verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete on the supplied diff. The production path preserves the decompressor-derived effectiveName, uses it for both parser format selection and the displayed preview, and leaves outer-name deduplication and status keys intact. The ZIP regression test exercises the real browser upload/decompression path with an N-Quads member whose named-graph syntax cannot be successfully parsed through the former Turtle fallback, then verifies the imported named-graph result. The zstd test likewise verifies decoded data is queryable. The comments accurately exclude unsupported tar-gzip archives. No new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is apparent. Because round 2 also had no findings and approved the same material behavior, progress is stagnant under the required comparison scale.
